visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Explicit Conversions Instead of Tricks
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The conversions use the unary plus, an empty string and a double negation. Write them with Number, String and Boolean. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Number("42") says what it does, while +"42" has to be recognised as a conversion. Readable code avoids relying on the coercion rules of operators.
